assertion_audit.failure_condition: First expected set fails if any held run is omitted or added; positive counters fail if the instrument observes no derivation, stat, registry, live or directory work; warm expected-set assertions fail if reuse loses content; the zero counter fails if unchanged refresh repeats discovery or held-path stats; the added-tree set and derive counter fail if registry changes do not invalidate. added.is_dir is fixture sanity, not regression coverage.
The independent literal run-id sets fail if changing a live claim or rewriting the release record leaves the old held record cached.
Renaming the registered directory without updating Git must remove held-run-0; removal of parent-presence validation leaves that id and fails.

len(expected)==20 rejects an empty initial result; result parity rejects lost rows; independent derive==0 counters fail if unrelated pointer creation, a phase-only pointer rewrite, an unregistered claim or sibling-file churn is put back into the held-answer key. Parity alone is not counted as a semantic oracle.

The retained parity and nonempty assertions compare two routes; the new explicit cache clear makes the retained index.calls==2 fail if the explicit-root route loses its second index build rather than accepting a cached held result.
